occurrences.documentation_raw:
gui_api.CreateDockPanel(title: str, side: str = "right", name: str = "") -> int

Create a dockable panel owned by CLO, like the Library or History panels: it docks into the main window, can be dragged to another side or floated, and has the CLO title bar. Use it as the parent of Add* calls and show it with ShowWindow. ShowWindow, CloseWindow, CloseAllWindows, SetWindowCloseCallback and SetWidgetText accept the panel handle.

- ``title``: Panel title shown in its title bar.
- ``side``: Initial docking side, one of left, right or bottom. Anything else fails.
- ``name``: Stable identifier (letters, digits, underscore). Panels with the same name keep their docking position across mode switches and sessions. Empty generates a name from the handle.

**Returns:** Panel handle (greater than 0) on success, 0 on failure or in headless mode.

|

parameter_docs_raw: - ``title``: Panel title shown in its title bar.
- ``side``: Initial docking side, one of left, right or bottom. Anything else fails.
- ``name``: Stable identifier (letters, digits, underscore). Panels with the same name keep their docking position across mode switches and sessions. Empty generates a name from the handle.
return_docs_raw: **Returns:** Panel handle (greater than 0) on success, 0 on failure or in headless mode.

gui_api.SetTableRows(handle: int, rows: list[list[str]]) -> bool

Replace every row of a table created by AddTable. The selection is reset.

- ``handle``: Table handle.
- ``rows``: Cell texts, one inner list per row.

**Returns:** true on success, false when the handle is not a table or in headless mode.

|

Data types
----------

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 1
   :widths: 30 70

   * - Type
     - Fields
   * - ``ApiTypes.CloApiGuiTextResult``
     - ``accepted`` (bool): True only when the user pressed OK.
       ``value`` (str): the entered text, empty unless accepted.
   * - ``ApiTypes.CloApiGuiChoiceResult``
     - ``accepted`` (bool).
       ``selectedIndex`` (int): the picked option (AskChoice) or the first checked one (AskMultiChoice), -1 unless accepted.
       ``selectedValue`` (str): caption of that option.
       ``selectedIndices`` (list[int]): every selected index in ascending order.
   * - ``ApiTypes.CloApiGuiFormResult``
     - ``accepted`` (bool).
       ``values`` (dict[str, str]): field key to value as text.
   * - ``ApiTypes.CloApiGuiFormField``
     - ``key`` (str): unique result key. ``label`` (str): caption next to the input.
       ``type``: one of the field types below (default ``GUI_FIELD_TEXT``).
       ``defaultValue`` (str): initial value as text. ``options`` (list[str]): captions for ``GUI_FIELD_CHOICE``.

.. list-table:: Form field types
   :header-rows: 1
   :widths: 35 65

   * - Constant
     - Input and value
   * - ``ApiTypes.GUI_FIELD_TEXT``
     - Single-line text input. Value: the entered text.
   * - ``ApiTypes.GUI_FIELD_CHOICE``
     - Drop-down built from ``options``. Value: the selected caption.
   * - ``ApiTypes.GUI_FIELD_CHECK``
     - Check box. Value: ``true`` or ``false``.
   * - ``ApiTypes.GUI_FIELD_NUMBER``
     - Decimal number input. Value: the number as decimal text.

parameter_docs_raw: - ``handle``: Table handle.
- ``rows``: Cell texts, one inner list per row.
return_docs_raw: **Returns:** true on success, false when the handle is not a table or in headless mode.
